title: Log in with a wizard already made, play it and stand in Ravenwood
notes: The run seeds its account's one wizard before the client starts: a Fire wizard in WizardCity/WC_Ravenwood,
named from the install's own name tables and dressed in a look the client's own creation screens wrote.
The client lists it, and the run presses Play; the client's own -C option is not used, because it asks the
server to create a wizard from a bare name rather than choosing the one listed.
The login server hands the client to the scratch game server, which spends the key, loads the wizard,
puts it in the zone's public instance and sends MSG_LOGINCOMPLETE with its object; the client loads the
zone and says so with MSG_CLIENTZONED, which is when the wizard stands in the world.
The login server starts before the game server has extracted the creation tables and announced its
realm, so its two warnings about both being empty are expected here.
Entering the world, the client asks the game server for its buddies, mail, ladders, crowns, subscriptions,
tutorial log and more, and sends its first move; none is answered yet, and 4.12 and phase 5 answer them.
It then waits for the client's next keepalive on the game server, so a session closed after the wizard
stands fails the run rather than passing it; the game server's dropped-message burst fits the chatter above.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
